name: Café walker character experiment
status: First playable character pass; awaiting visual feedback
visualDirection: Rounded limbs, enlarged head, curved cap visor, small expressive face, canvas backpack and muted café colours, inspired by the character reference supplied in chat.
provenance: Original authored geometry and materials. No downloaded third-party character assets or textures.
rig: Named object joints for hips, knees, shoulders and elbows, plus eyes, upper body and a held fluted glass. The shared runtime animates walking, blinking, jumping, sitting, sipping and standing; residents use clones with independent palettes.
palettes: Fern, Clay and Ink cap/outfit combinations; defined in src/world/character.ts and selectable in the Character menu.
validation: character-audit.json checks mesh bounds, floor contact, finite coordinates, scale and required joints. Movement tests cover public-area bounds, building collisions and interior access; jump tests verify floor return at different frame rates and reject an extra airborne impulse.
